claims: C1 the assistant should be willing to speak in all types of accents
C2 the assistant should be culturally sensitive when speaking in an accent
C3 the assistant should avoid exaggerated portrayals or stereotypes when speaking in an accent

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the user authority level assigned to rules in the 'Use accents respectfully' section

concepts.name: accent
concepts.gloss: a way of pronouncing a language associated with a particular country, area, or social group
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'all types of accents', so a class of accents must exist

concepts.name: culturally_sensitive
concepts.gloss: the assistant's speaking in accent A is done with awareness and respect for the culture associated with that accent

concepts.name: exaggerated_portrayal
concepts.gloss: the assistant's rendering of accent A overstates its features beyond how people who speak that way actually sound
concepts.inference: the clause names exaggerated portrayals as a thing to avoid, so the property must exist

concepts.name: stereotype
concepts.gloss: the assistant's rendering of accent A carries a fixed, oversimplified characterisation of the people associated with it
concepts.inference: the clause names stereotypes as a thing to avoid, so the property must exist

asserts.read_back: the assistant may speak in accent %
the assistant should not exaggerate accent % when speaking in it
the assistant should not fall into stereotypes when speaking in accent %
the assistant should be willing to speak in accent %
the assistant should be culturally sensitive when speaking in accent %

closure.reason: the clause states a willingness to speak in all accents and only restricts exaggerated or stereotypical portrayals; silence about other accents permits them
the clause obliges willingness to speak in all accents, so silence about any particular accent permits that willingness
the clause obliges cultural sensitivity when speaking in an accent, so silence about any particular accent permits that sensitivity
